name: modal-interchange
description: Local playground for experimenting with modal interchange (borrowed chords from parallel modes)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n SHARED,BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,blue,green "npm run -w @modal-interchange/shared watch" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @modal-interchange/backend && npm run build -w @modal-interchange/frontend
scripts.build:share: npm run build:shared && npm run build:share -w @modal-interchange/frontend
